from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
sql = '''WITH genre_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.BillingCountry AS country,
        t.GenreId AS genre_id,
        g.Name AS genre,
        SUM(CAST(ROUND(il.UnitPrice * 100, 0) AS INTEGER) * il.Quantity) AS revenue_cents,
        SUM(il.Quantity) AS units
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
    JOIN Genre AS g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
    WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2021-01-01'
      AND i.InvoiceDate < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY i.BillingCountry, t.GenreId, g.Name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        genre_id,
        genre,
        revenue_cents,
        units,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC, genre_id ASC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM genre_sales
)
SELECT
    country AS country,
    genre_id AS genre_id,
    genre AS genre,
    revenue_cents AS revenue_cents,
    units AS units,
    country_rank AS country_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE country_rank <= 2
ORDER BY country ASC, country_rank ASC;
'''
path=Path('/work/query.sql')
path.write_text(sql)
con=sqlite3.connect('file:/inputs/Chinook.sqlite?mode=ro', uri=True)
steps=[0]
def progress():
    steps[0]+=100
    if steps[0]>2_000_000: return 1
    return 0
con.set_progress_handler(progress,100)
cur=con.execute(path.read_text())
print('columns:', [d[0] for d in cur.description])
rows=cur.fetchall()
print('row count:',len(rows),'approx VM steps:',steps[0])
print(*rows[:10], sep='\n')
print('sql bytes:',len(path.read_bytes()))
print('input query_only:',con.execute('PRAGMA query_only').fetchone())
con.close()
